transcript: Teacher: Your son is doing really well in the class. But he needs to focus more on English. Mother: yes... haan.. okay. Mother (to herself): मुझे english नहीं आती. मुझे कुछ समझ नहीं आया teacher ने क्या बोला [I don't know English. I didn't understand anything the teacher said]. Cockroach: क्या हुआ बहन? मुझे घूर के teacher की बात समझ आ जाएगी क्या? English नहीं आती नहीं, इसलिए मच्छर, मक्खी... sorry, cockroach गिन रही है [What happened, sister? Will staring at me make you understand the teacher? You don't know English, so you're counting mosquitoes, flies... sorry, cockroaches]. Mother: तू... तू बोल रही है? [You... you are speaking?] Cockroach: oh yes, I speak. I also speak English. I understand what the teacher says. Mother: पर कैसे? [But how?] Cockroach: सुन बहन. English Seekho app डाल. बस 14 दिन का challenge ले. ये महीना खत्म होते होते तू English बोलने लगेगी. पहले हफ्ते video देख. अंदर छोटे-छोटे videos हैं, 2 से 5 minute के. English को सीधी Hindi में समझाते हैं. Grammar का रट्टा नहीं लगवाते. रोज बोलचाल वाली english, teacher से क्या बात करनी है, बच्चे से क्या बात करनी है, इस सब पर videos हैं. दूसरे हफ्ते Disha maam के साथ practice कर. AI teacher है, 24 घंटे तेरेसे बात करेगी. सुबह 5 बजे message कर या रात के 12 बजे. लिख कर या बोल कर, वो जवाब देगी और सिखाएगी. जितनी बार गलत बोल, उतनी बार सुधारेगी. ना हँसेगी, ना बोलेगी इतनी सी बात नहीं आती. रोज सिर्फ 15 minute. बस 1 रुपये में 3 दिन का trial ले और खुद देख ले. [Listen sister. Download English Seekho app. Take a 14-day challenge. By month-end, you'll speak English. First week, watch 2-5 min videos explaining English in Hindi without rote grammar. Second week, practice with Disha maam, an AI teacher available 24/7 who corrects you without judgment. Just 15 minutes daily. Take a 3-day trial for 1 rupee.] Mother (later, to teacher): Ma'am, I checked his notebook. His spelling has improved, but I want to work on his reading. What do you suggest? Cockroach: ₹1 में English Seekho का trial लें. रोज 15 minute video देख फिर Disha maam के साथ practice कर और बस फिर फटाफट English बोल, बहन के जैसे. तो install button पर click करो और English Seekho app download करो. [Take English Seekho trial for ₹1. Watch 15 mins daily, practice with Disha maam, and speak fluent English. Click install to download.]

summary: A mother feels embarrassed at a parent-teacher meeting because she cannot understand English. A talking cockroach character appears and advises her to download the English Seekho app, highlighting its 14-day challenge, short Hindi-to-English videos, and 24/7 AI teacher practice. The ad ends with the mother confidently speaking English to the teacher and a call to action to download the app for a 1-rupee trial.
